{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Insects?'' Our survey said this planet was lifeless!|[[Reynar]]|<ref name="Deadly Allies">{{TCWComicCite|6.51|Deadly Allies}}</ref>}}
[[File:Bug.jpg|thumb|right|180px|A type of insect [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Omphalos]].]]
'''Insects''' were a class of [[Arthropod/Legends|arthropods]]. Most insects had a well-defined, segmented body that consisted of a head, a thorax, and an abdomen. However, some [[Species/Legends|species]] had evolved into other forms, including the [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] configuration. Insects usually had an exoskeleton, and some had wings. They could have any number of jointed [[Limb/Legends|limbs]].<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> The average insect, found on a million worlds, knew how to eat, [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduce]], and more or less avoid dangers.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> There existed [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] insectoids, and those could have a variety of [[Diet/Legends|diets]], from carnivorous and omnivorous to herbivorous and scavenger.<ref name="AE" />

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
As explained in ''[[Alien Encounters]]'', a [[1998]] supplement to ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', [[Wikipedia:Insect|insects]] and [[Wikipedia:Arachnid|arachnids]] in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe are lumped in together in the [[Wikipedia:Arthropod|arthropod]] group for simplicity's sake.<ref name="AE" /> In real life, all insects have six segmented legs, while arachnids have eight.<ref name="Insects">{{WebCite|url=http://www.entomology.umn.edu/cues/4015/morpology|text=Insect Morphology|work=[http://www.entomology.umn.edu University of Minnesota: Department of Entomology]|archivedate=20050325081001}}</ref>
